name: Akiflow
description: Akiflow is a daily planning and time-blocking app that brings tasks and calendars into one focused workspace. People use it to capture work in a universal inbox, organize projects and priorities, plan tasks onto a schedule, manage time slots and connected calendars, and turn meeting notes into action.
agentUseSummary: Connect an Akiflow account once, then select which agents can read or manage its authorized tasks, schedule, calendars, time slots, and meeting material under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read tasks, schedules, calendars, and meetings
capabilities.description: Read authorized tasks, inbox and someday work, projects, tags, priorities, schedules, time slots, connected calendars, events, meeting briefs, recordings, summaries, action items, and transcripts.

capabilities.label: Manage tasks, plans, time slots, and events
capabilities.description: Create and update tasks, plan or unschedule work, mark tasks complete, create and edit time slots, and create, edit, or cancel authorized connected-calendar events.

allowed.label: Read Akiflow
allowed.description: Use one verified Akiflow MCP read tool with bounded arguments.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Akiflow
approvalRequired.description: Use one verified task, planning, time-slot, or calendar mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Mount raw MCP
blocked.description: Relay exposes typed read and manage wrappers rather than an ungoverned provider tool surface.

blocked.label: Use another MCP origin
blocked.description: OAuth tokens are attached only to Akiflow's published hosted MCP resource.

blocked.label: Expose OAuth credentials
blocked.description: OAuth tokens stay encrypted and never enter agent-visible arguments or results.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded transfer
blocked.description: Relay bounds live schemas, arguments, result sizes, nesting, pagination, redirects, and execution time.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Verified reads run directly. Every task, planning, time-slot, calendar, guest-notification, or other provider mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized Akiflow operation runs without Relay per-action approval. Connection ownership, provider authority, live schema verification, fixed origin, bounds, credential protection, provider limits, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway verifies Akiflow's live MCP schemas and mounts bounded read and manage wrappers with refreshed OAuth attached only to the fixed hosted endpoint.
Railway verifies Akiflow's live MCP schemas and mounts bounded read and manage wrappers with refreshed OAuth attached only to the fixed hosted endpoint.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay Console's public S256 PKCE client is dynamically registered with Akiflow and its non-secret client ID is configured on Railway. A signed-in Akiflow subscriber with representative data is still required for production OAuth and MCP acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: An Akiflow user clicks Connect, approves mcp:read and mcp:write, then Relay verifies callback, refresh, all 22 live tools, representative reads, Safe mutation denial and approval, Dangerous task and calendar management, redaction, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Akiflow documents its hosted MCP resource, sign-in connection, task and schedule reads, task planning and updates, time-slot management, connected-calendar event creation and editing, and Meeting Assistant transcript access.
Akiflow publishes the exact MCP resource, Bearer authentication, authorization server, and mcp:read plus mcp:write scopes.
Akiflow publishes authorization, token, and dynamic-registration endpoints with authorization-code and refresh grants, public client authentication, and S256 PKCE.
Akiflow's public product page confirms that the hosted MCP is live for tasks, calendars, meetings, priorities, and day planning.
